item.title: Sunday Social Dance — Sun Aug 16, 6:30 PM — Galaxy Dance Club
item.description:
Join us for an unforgettable evening of dance! Start your night with energizing salsa and bachata classes that will get your feet moving and your heart racing. After the classes, enjoy a lively social where you can show off your new moves! Dance the night away to a mix of salsa, bachata, cha cha, and kizomba music. item.title: 3D: Design & Game Creation Camp (August 17-21) — Mon Aug 17, 10:00 AM — Agincourt
item.description: Calling all creators, builders, and future game developers! Ready to take your ideas from the screen into the third dimension? Join us for an action-packed, 4-day summer workshop where you’ll learn to design 3D worlds and bring them to life. From creating your first 3D model to dipping your toes into video game design, this hands-on camp will take your digital skills to the next level. What We’re Learning: Day 1: Tinkercad – Master the basics of 3D building and shape manipulation. Day 2: Womp3D – Learn 3D sculpting to create smooth, organic, and gooey digital art. Day 3: Autodesk Fusion – Think like an engineer and dive into advanced, high-tech design. Day 4: Game Design Intro – Put your skills to the test and learn how to create a fun video game. Day 5: Drawing with Dash – Use block coding to create some simple shapes and do some free style drawing. The Details: Who: Creative kids ages 8 to 12 When: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM Whe
